universe: historical Shanghai/Shenzhen mainboard, including former SME; exclude financials using contemporaneous evidence, CDR and listing age <252 sessions
return_convention: prior-close planned adjusted share orders, opening fills subject to opening suspension and limit eligibility; only prior cash may fund buys, sale proceeds fund orders from next session; month-end net NAV
limitations: Daily-bar fills without queue, capacity or intraday matching
Actual next-session daily replacement is not an intraday immediate replacement
Historical point-in-time snapshots may contain vendor revisions
Early suspended-stock capitalization estimates affect ranks
No causal identification of shell value
Historical 2024-2025 holdout inspected before final rules

repair_policy.unresolved_terminal_policy: documented delisting-date zero valuation; 50/100 percent last-quote sensitivities

validation_disclosure: 2024-2025 historical holdout already inspected before final protocol update
st_policy: Known-risk exclusion at monthly close; risk holdings submit exit orders at first subsequent open, sell proceeds fund preplanned forward replacement from the next session. Monthly rank list stays frozen.
delisting_trading_policy: Names containing 退 identify publicly known delisting trading, never ordinary non-ST eligibility
replacement_policy: Prior-close candidate choice and fixed adjusted share quantity, funded only by prior available cash. No same-open reaction to another fill. Failed orders retry or advance only at the following planning close. Strategies independently use the monthly frozen rank list.
buy_budget_policy: Each order reserves quantity times the pre-open published upper-limit price plus cost; total reserved cash cannot exceed prior-close cash. Auction price savings are reused only at the next planning date.
historical_industry_policy: Contemporaneous backup industry (same day or <=1 prior session), then already-published CSRC quarterly classification; no SW retrospective membership or future report-end company-type fallback.
input_gate_policy: Preserve raw coverage gaps; require complete financial/capitalization inputs for observable nonrisk signal candidates. Stocks excluded by risk status already known on signal date cannot affect filtered rank.
